views.name: director_movies_ordered
views.body_sql: SELECT dm.name_id AS director_id, n.name AS director_name, dm.movie_id AS movie_id, m.date_published AS release_date, m.duration AS movie_duration, r.avg_rating AS rating, r.total_votes AS vote_count FROM director_mapping dm JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
views.description: combines director information with their directed movies, selecting director identifiers, release dates, durations, ratings, and vote counts to establish a chronological record per director

views.name: director_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    director_id,
    director_name,
    COUNT(movie_id) AS movie_count,
    AVG(diff) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
    AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(vote_count) AS total_votes,
    MIN(rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(movie_duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM (
    SELECT
        director_id,
        director_name,
        movie_id,
        rating,
        vote_count,
        movie_duration,
        movie_duration - LAG(movie_duration) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY release_date) AS diff
    FROM director_movies_ordered
)
GROUP BY director_id, director_name
views.description: computes per-director summary statistics including movie count, total votes, rating statistics, total duration, and average inter-movie duration derived from the chronological movie records
